summary: Defines the Port Control Protocol, which lets an IPv4 or IPv6 host control how incoming packets are translated and forwarded by a NAT or simple firewall. It also lets a host reduce its outgoing NAT keepalive messages.

eli5.summary: A computer behind a gate politely asks the gatekeeper to let certain visitors in and to remember them without constant check-ins.

questions: what is the port control protocol
how to open ports on a nat or firewall automatically
